lean.statement: ∀ {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (η : ℝ), 0 < η → Function.Involutive (fun p : E × E => (p.1, (2 : ℝ) • p.1 - p.2)) ∧ MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1, (2 : ℝ) • p.1 - p.2)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1, p.1 + Real.sqrt η • p.2)) (μ.prod (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E))) = MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun p : E × E => (p.1, p.1 + Real.sqrt η • p.2)) (μ.prod (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E))
approved_definition_context: Measure.map f m is the pushforward of measure m along f; the relevant maps are measurable here, so the totalized nonmeasurable fallback is not invoked. Measure.prod is the product measure and encodes independence. stdGaussian E is the centered standard Gaussian with identity covariance on the finite-dimensional real inner-product space E. Function.Involutive f means f (f x) = x for every x. BorelSpace identifies measurable sets with the topology's Borel sets; IsProbabilityMeasure means total mass one. Real.sqrt is the nonnegative square root, and • is scalar multiplication.
